summary: Focused re-test of hero label overlap fix from iteration_3. Verified at viewports 320, 359, and 390 that .hero-location and .scroll-cue no longer intersect, are both visible, and neither overlaps .masthead-tagline. No horizontal overflow at any of the three widths.

390.note: scroll-cue bottom placement unchanged vs iteration_3 baseline (media query only affects <=359px).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero label overlap issue at narrow widths (<=359px) resolved via @media(max-width:359px){.scroll-cue{bottom:6rem}}. Confirmed at 320/359/390. Only overlap-focused re-test performed per request; no other flows re-run.
rca of the issue: At <=359px the .scroll-cue at its default bottom offset visually overlapped .hero-location. Raising bottom to 6rem inside a max-width:359px media query lifts the cue above the location line at narrow viewports while leaving 390+ untouched. Verified via bounding-box intersection tests.
